evidence.why: Role is taken from client request body and applied directly to the user's own record identified by session.user.id, allowing self privilege escalation (e.g. to ADMIN).

evidence.snippet: const updatedUser = await db.user.update({ where: { id: userId, userId: session.user.id }, data: updatePayload });
evidence.why: The update is scoped to the session user themselves, so the role field they are updating governs their own permissions — a role writable by the user it governs.

controls_present: ownership predicate bound to session.user.id in WHERE clause
zod schema validation of body and id
